planned_cases.requirement: Begin leaves hardware disabled until helper cancellation has succeeded.
A record can be claimed only after its full payload and then its committed count.
A sample past capacity sticks LOSS, keeps every unread record, and overwrites none.
Explicit uncertainty on an empty inbox sticks LOSS, independent of the saturating counter.
Claim copies one record and issues no helper, owner, render, wait, or scan inside exclusion.
Release restores the prior exclusion state and does not globally enable interrupts;delivery requires an otherwise capture-permitting foreground context.
The claimed delivery finishes after a newer loss; the next record waits until one cancel path completes.
Foreground stop discards unread data and the undelivered claim, then uses one helper stop, with no producer callback.
Rebaseline accepts only a post-barrier fresh zero-motion observation; queued motion is not trusted drag; held left stays suppressed.
A second loss view does not cancel twice, and an empty drain is not treated as a loss cancel.
A stale epoch is refused, maximum-epoch restart has no effect, and the first fault is retained.
The producer is quiescent before rebind, does not nest, and does not preempt inside exclusion.
A baseline published before foreground rebaseline stages later records;loss before/during rebaseline takes the correct WAIT/READY cancellation path without a blind interval.
Ordered -1,+1 at a pointer boundary remains distinct;neither producer clamping nor coalescing changes the existing owner result.
